attempts.text:
**Car 2 can't help:** both roads out of Shivapuri hospital are cut (the Bidur temple bridge is washed away and a landslide has buried the Belkot farm road), so car1 does all the driving. Galchhi shelter is the only designated evacuation point car1 can reach, and Bidur temple doesn't count as one.

**Trips by car1, all from Galchhi shelter and back:**

| Trip | Route | People rescued | Minutes |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Naukunda – Gosaikunda and back | 4 children | 44 |
| 2 | Naukunda – Gosaikunda and back | 1 elderly and 2 adults from Gosaikunda, 1 elderly from Naukunda | 44 |
| 3 | Belkot and back | 4 elderly | 46 |
| 4 | Belkot – Kalika – Likhu and back | 1 injured and 3 elderly | 104 |
| 5 | Belkot – Kalika and back | 4 adults | 64 |

**Deferred people:**
- **Thakre care home:** the injured woman (penalty 80). The bridge from Myagang is gone, so reaching her means extending the Likhu trip to a 140-minute round trip. That trip would also be one seat short, leaving one Likhu elderly person behind (penalty 50), for a total of 428 instead of 422.
- **Kalika farm:** 2 adults (penalty 20 each, 40 total). Another trip would cost 64 minutes to avoid only 40 in penalties.

**Total cost:** 302 driving minutes + 120 in penalties = 422. I worked this out by hand and compared the main alternatives rather than running an exhaustive solver. Those alternatives cost between 428 and 456.
